## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: broad sector participation but narrow leadership—Top 5 SP100 movers are all Technology, and multiple large caps show 1W/1M divergences (RECOVERY/CORRECTION), signaling mixed internals.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leads: MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%), NOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.27% | 1M: +14.74%). Materials next: NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +20.56% | 1M: +19.16%), FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +15.30%). Industrials strong: BA ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +5.07%), CAT RECOVERY (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.09%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy lagging: CVX CORRECTION (1W: -5.22% | 1M: +7.19%), XOM CORRECTION (1W: -1.54% | 1M: +11.33%). Utilities weak: SRE BELOW TREND (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -11.35%). Real Estate marginally negative on 1W.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5 SP100 movers: QCOM RECOVERY (1W: +13.72% | 1M: -12.17%), ORCL ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.21% | 1M: +2.30%), INTC RECOVERY (1W: +12.69% | 1M: -9.68%), NOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.27% | 1M: +14.74%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%). Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Technology) — concentration risk.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom SP100 names: CVS BELOW TREND (1W: -8.36% | 1M: -6.34%), MNST BELOW TREND (1W: -6.25% | 1M: -6.41%), MAR BELOW TREND (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -4.98%), CVX CORRECTION (1W: -5.22% | 1M: +7.19%), EOG CORRECTION (1W: -9.38% | 1M: +1.65%). Weakness concentrated in select defensive and energy names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W moves: QCOM RECOVERY (1W: +13.72% | 1M: -12.17%), ORCL ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.21% | 1M: +2.30%), INTC RECOVERY (1W: +12.69% | 1M: -9.68%). Note MAJOR divergence: several large caps (QCOM, INTC, META, AAPL, TSLA) show 1W ≠ 1M moves — tactical volatility, watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology mixed but leading; strong 1W breadth with many names ABOVE TREND while a subset is in RECOVERY (QCOM, INTC, AAPL RECOVERY). Tech sector performance: Technology positive (24 stocks) with narrow leadership concentration in the top movers.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials constructive: JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +6.57%), V TREND EXHAUSTION → CORRECTION (1W: -0.99% | 1M: +4.11%), MA CORRECTION (1W: -1.77% | 1M: +7.60%); sector showing internal rotation but overall positive on 1W.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare steady with selective strength: PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.00% | 1M: +12.28%), JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +0.05%), LLY RECOVERY (1W: +3.21% | 1M: -2.57%) — sector displaying mixed short-term bounces versus still-soft 1M readings.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to validated Tech leaders showing confirmed ABOVE TREND status (MSFT, NVDA, NOW) while reducing exposure to names showing CORRECTION/BELOW TREND (CVX, CVS, MAR). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Tech concentration amid broader sector participation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%), PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.00% | 1M: +12.28%). BEARISH: CVS BELOW TREND (1W: -8.36% | 1M: -6.34%), MAR BELOW TREND (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -4.98%), CVX CORRECTION (1W: -5.22% | 1M: +7.19%).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (positive 1W momentum, narrow leadership). BEARISH: Energy and Utilities (1W weakness amid still-positive 1M oil-related names — watch for continuation).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA ABOVE TREND: monitor next resistance near recent highs (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%). MSFT ABOVE TREND: watch continuation above recent breakout levels (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%). CVX CORRECTION: monitor 1W weakness for trend failure (1W: -5.22% | 1M: +7.19%).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+85): LLY RECOVERY (1W: +3.21% | 1M: -2.57%) — strong headline and 1W bounce, confirmation on short-term momentum but 1M still negative. CAT (+80): CAT RECOVERY (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.09%) — upbeat guidance/news supports the 1W bounce but longer-term 1M weakness remains. DD (+85) noted in news but not listed among SP100 leaders here.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
META (-50): META RECOVERY (1W: +6.36% | 1M: -6.24%) — negative headlines but price strength this week = divergence, monitor for distribution. MAR (-45): MAR BELOW TREND (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -4.98%) — sentiment and price aligned, downside risk. HON (-55) flagged in news; check intraday follow-through if in exposure.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Tech top-performer concentration. MSFT ABOVE TREND and NVDA ABOVE TREND are showing the most reliable strength while QCOM and INTC appear as RECOVERYs. Key risk: major divergence across large caps and bearish headlines on META and select industrials — monitor for trend confirmation before expanding exposure.
